name: TP-Link Omada
description: Reads an Omada controller (5.1 or newer): gateway, switches and access points, which device hangs below which, which switch or access point each client is connected to, with Wi-Fi signal, band and link rate, switch ports and, with an Open API client, application statistics (DPI). Read-only. Not yet tested on real hardware.
author: Netlens
supports: OC200 / OC300 hardware controllers (not yet tested)

releases.changelog: Run diagnostic now shows what the Open API answers for the application statistics (the application list, and three clients in three time windows), and the busiest clients are read first. For a controller where the connection test works but no applications come back.

Application statistics per device (shown on the device's Network tab) and the new switch Settings > Traffic statistics in Netlens 0.4.161 (off by default; while off the controller is not asked). Needs Netlens 0.4.161.

Application statistics for Statistics > Network > Applications: enter an Open API client ID and secret (Omada: Settings > Platform Integration > Open API, Client Credentials, Viewer) and switch DPI on at the gateway. Read per client through the Open API and added up. Optional: without the client nothing changes. Tested against a simulated controller only; Test connection and Run diagnostic say whether it works.

Reads the ports of every switch (link state, speed, duplex, byte counters) for the Switch ports card, the faceplate, traffic graphs and link events, and tells which switch port each wired client sits on (needs Netlens 0.4.154 or newer). Written from the controller's documented fields and tested against a simulated controller only; Run diagnostic shows whether the ports were understood.
Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
First release. Written from the public API and tested against a simulated controller only: please test it on real hardware and report back (see the README).
Errors now name the step that failed. The client list is requested the way more controller versions accept it (fixes 'general error -1' reported by a tester).
Adds a diagnostic report: the plugin's page has a Run diagnostic button (Netlens 0.2.67 or newer) that produces an anonymised description of what the controller answers, to copy or download.
